notes.title: Someday You'll Return: Director's Cut - Photo Mode Contest
notes.content:
What would you do if your daughter went missing? How far would you go to track her down? Venture into the old Moravian woods to find Stela, and unveil the shroud of your sanity in the process. Someday is a critically acclaimed game of [b]psychological horror[/b] that has been polished, expanded, and rereleased in this new [url=https://somedaygame.com]Director’s Cut[/url].

Find out what happened by visiting the place where tragedy first struck. Use your wits, map, and tourist tracks to navigate the mysterious landscape. The forest is full of old memories, abandoned camps, murky swamps, and collapsed bunkers. Discover local stories to solve otherworldly puzzles and maneuver through locations you once knew so well. And don’t forget to keep your head down. Something out there might be watching.

If you haven't already, now is the best time to get yourself Someday You'll Return: Director's Cut on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/agecheck/app/2229350/]Steam[/url] or [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-cz/product/EP2601-PPSA13739_00-0349660830475677]PlayStation[/url].

The game offers an [b]incredible atmosphere[/b] and [b]countless beautiful[/b] locations that you would just love to stay in and just enjoy the surroundings.

After immersing yourself in the mysterious atmosphere of Someday, you can then also show the world your favorite places or moments from the game, and even [b]win lots of amazing prizes[/b].

That's why we have prepared a [b]Photo Mode Contest[/b] for you.

Photo Mode was one of the many new features added to Director's Cut. It allows you to [b]capture your favorite moments[/b] and also edit them fully, right in the game.

[previewyoutube=g-tPxqkB7Ds;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h2][b]How it works[/b][/h2]

After you create your in-game photo, just head over to our [url=https://www.facebook.com/BohemiaInteractive/posts/pfbid0zsr5xFgCp3mYtf5TJA6gk2b45MVmxGtsU6mN5h3ebBwr3GeDEKFD4cDxS2YBUJEQl]Facebook[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/bohemiainteract/status/1666099636887769089]Twitter[/url] and add your creation in the comments section below our post announcing the contest. And that's it, you're in the competition!

The top [b]5 contestants[/b] will be chosen based on the number of reactions to their competing photo under this post. So, even if you are not competing yourself, make sure to [b]show some love by liking[/b] your favorite entries.

From the five selected candidates, [b]the top 3 will be chosen by a jury[/b] consisting of Bohemia Interactive employees. All five entries will also be [b]featured on our social media[/b].

The contest runs from June 6th (5:00 PM CEST) to June 20th (11:59 PM CEST).

[h2][b]Prices[/b][/h2]

[b]1st place[/b] can look forward to a [b]signed poster[/b] from the game's developer Jan Kavan and Bohemia Interactive CEO Marek Španěl, a [b]Steam Gift Card worth 50 €[/b], a [url=https://www.bohemia.net/games]free digital copy of our game[/url] of the winner's choosing, and a [b]50% discount on your next order[/b] on [url=https://store.bistudio.com]Bohemia Store[/url].

[b]2nd place[/b] will compete for a [b]25 € Steam Gift Card[/b], a [b]free digital copy of our game,[/b] and a [b]50% discount[/b].

[b]3rd place[/b] wins a [b]10 € Steam Gift Card[/b], a [b]free digital copy of our game[/b], and a [b]50% discount[/b].

And lastly, [b]4th and 5th places[/b] will receive a [b]free digital copy of our game[/b], and a [b]50% discount[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730611/dbc1caea4b127470b82b4a4399d0de611777fcda.jpg[/img]

Full terms and conditions of the competition can be found [url=https://www.bohemia.net/blog/contest-rules-sdyr-photo-mode?showArt=1]here[/url].

We look forward to your entries!

notes.title: Trading cards are here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730611/9d2c451207158714c6b01d6d73a71cc35076bddd.jpg[/img]

Today we’re releasing trading cards for Someday You’ll Return: Director’s Cut! You can already start collecting them by simply progressing through the game. There are 10 trading cards in total, all of them decorated with beautiful concept art illustrating how the game came to be. 

Want more Someday atmosphere in your Steam? Then head on over to the Steam Point Shop! You can unlock 4 brand new Steam Profile backgrounds, each with its own bone-chilling design. Last but not least, you can also browse through 8 emoticons to disturb your Steam friends with in chat! 

We’re sure that Someday you’ll have all of them. 

Happy collecting!

notes.title: Someday You’ll Return: Director’s Cut is out now!
notes.content:
Someday is a critically acclaimed game of psychological horror that has been polished, expanded, and rereleased in this new Director’s Cut. Check out the release trailer!

[previewyoutube=_QBzYpM5FrM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]How Far Are You Willing To Go?[/b]

Someday You’ll Return: Director’s Cut is an immersive psychological horror that centers around the search for Stela, a young daughter lost in the forests of South Moravia. You play Stela’s father Daniel, a man who vowed to stay away from the very woods he must enter again. 

What’s real and what’s not real? The answer lies buried in a world full of memories, in gloomy swamps and abandoned camps, a landscape full of magic and danger. 

Collect helpful items and create new artifacts, craft mystical potions with the ancient art of alchemy, unlock puzzles to advance the story and uncover the truth about Stela.   

The original Someday You’ll Return was released in 2020 by CBE Software. This immersive psychological horror has been enhanced and expanded in cooperation with Bohemia Interactive, and rereleased as Someday You’ll Return: Director’s Cut.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730611/aca940fe8d91ac81651cb41b8245dfdba37bb5cb.jpg[/img]

The significantly improved Someday You’ll Return: Director’s Cut includes: 

• New puzzles
• New story elements
• Smoother and more dynamic gameplay
• New interactive tutorial for alchemy and herbalism
• Enhanced sound
• Over 30 minutes of new music


[b]Find Stela now![/b]
